text: Running a team of AI agents? Agent Company turns it into a game you can play.
Forge a character. Its class is its job.
Its origin is the tool it runs on.
Then fit the OpenProof harness: six limits it works within.
Drag your team onto the map. Put someone in the wrong slot, and the map refuses.
When the ring turns green, sound the horn.
The orders are written straight into your repository.
Then the work runs down the line. Tests first, a challenger, an independent review.
When a quest comes back, no proof means no XP.
An OpenProof evidence record seals it for full credit.
Incidents cost the agent that caused them.
Play it in any world, or build your own.
Agent Company. Free and open source, for any agent tool.
